newsitem.title: USA: Dental Services says shares returned.
newsitem.headline: Dental Services says shares returned.

text.p: Dental Services of America Inc said Wednesday 1,551,500 shares of common stock were returned to its treasury by certain shareholders, reducing its outstanding shares by about 20 percent.
Dental Services said the shares were originally obtained by the shareholders when the company acquired Dental Practice Administrators Inc in July, 1996.
A spokesman declined to comment on why the shares were returned.
Dental Services also said it expects to conclude the acquisition of a dental care center in Tampa, Florida within the next 90 days.
The company also said its board extended the expiration date of its private warrants and publicly traded class B warrants until December 27.
